semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in manufacturing critical semiconductor equipment, particularly CMP modules, which are essential for wafer processing.
summary: Mingyang Semiconductor Technology (Hefei) Co., Ltd. is a key player in the semiconductor equipment sector, focusing on the production of chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) modules. They offer comprehensive support for equipment upgrades and collaborate with customers to optimize CMP processes, enhancing yield and consistency.
capabilities: Third 8-inch CMP platform with 'dry-in, dry-out' function
Modular CMP platform for PolySi, GaN, and diamond materials
OEM/ODM technical services for production line customization

regional_presence.China: The company has widely deployed its CMP equipment across various customer sites in China.
